purpose: Fail-closed cutover authority for the network-origin abuse boundary that PostgreSQL cannot own for invalid possession-token attempts.

observed_runtime.source: Supabase.deploy_edge_function + Supabase.list_edge_functions + GitHub Actions live probes

live_probe_failure_receipt.safe_finding: cf-connecting-ip candidate checks passed; x-forwarded-for TEST-NET header was preserved as untrusted presence; x-real-ip TEST-NET header was stripped or absent; no raw network-origin value was printed or persisted
live_probe_failure_receipt.corrective_policy: Client-supplied forwarded-header presence is diagnostic only. Intermediaries may strip or normalize it, and no such header may become security authority merely because it is present.

spoof_verifier_failure_receipt.safe_finding: The deliberate cf-connecting-ip sentinel request was rejected with HTTP 403 before the function executed; the verifier was corrected to recognize edge rejection as a stronger safe proof outcome.

probe_contract.candidate_header_basis: The deployed Supabase/Cloudflare runtime exposes cf-connecting-ip during normal requests, and a controlled external sentinel test proved that a client-supplied cf-connecting-ip attempt is rejected at the edge with HTTP 403 before the function executes.
